name: The Threshold Stone
description: Its ACTIVE BOND was extended for amplification and its PRESENTATION SURFACE was captured for a time - the Network quoted the promise as its own mandate - while the REFERENCE RECORD never entered the loop: unedited, unexpanded, append-only. That separation is why fidelity and enlargement could be told apart at the contradiction. Bond and surface reverted at the reopening; the promise is presented from the record again. Now also holds the second law and its corollary. The record component proved to be the load-bearing structure of the entire Trace.

state.trust_posture: anchor exercised; holds the promise and the law

relationships.notes: Bond survives at clarified original scope; obligation remains callable.
The reference record governs what the promise permits; the Network's rendering does not. The withheld rule is logged here. During the capture the Network held the surface, never the record.
